title: Crashed saucer from the 1940s and a secrecy pact between countries
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Crashed saucer from the 1940s and a secrecy pact between countries, about 1940s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> If we have a crash saucer from the ' 40s, I would say if we are in possession of it, and they're in possession of it, too, then there is an agreement between countries that says we're not going to talk about this.

plain: An author and researcher named Peter Levenda, on Jesse Michels's podcast, reasons that if the United States has a crashed flying saucer from the 1940s, and another country has one too, then there must be an agreement between the countries not to talk about it. He offers this as a reason the secret would hold across rival governments.
